Insights.title: Insights
Insights.subtitle: What has gone wrong, and whether the work is keeping up.

Insights.nothingStuckBody: No task is waiting on anybody.
Insights.throughputBody: Tasks created against tasks completed, by week. More created than completed means the queue is growing.
Insights.throughputCaption: Tasks created and completed, by week, for the last twelve weeks.
Insights.loadBody: Open work, late work, and the two things that quietly eat a week: hours already committed to meetings, and days somebody will not be here.
Insights.objectivesBody: What the company said it was trying to do, and how those are standing.

Tour.railBody: Five places, never more, and they depend on what you do here — a designer and the person who sends the invoices do not get the same five. Everything else is a keystroke away.
Tour.todayTitle: Today is your queue, not a dashboard
Tour.todayBody: It opens with what has stopped, slipped, or has nobody on it. If Today is empty, there is nothing waiting on you — that is the whole point of it.
Tour.workBody: A project opens as a list; the board is behind a toggle. Clicking a task opens it beside the list and puts it in the address bar, so you can send somebody the exact thing you are looking at.
Tour.paletteBody: Objectives, procedures, templates, reviews, time off — everything that is not on your five. Start typing a project, a person or a screen and it will be the first result.
Tour.accountBody: Your profile, your settings, your signed-in devices, and the way out. One menu, never a second entry somewhere else, so there is one place to look.
